NAME: CPU core verification plan
details: Block 1: garuda_core_top, RV32IM, machine mode only, five stages, CLIC interrupts, WFI clock gate. Source: GARUDA-CORE-SPEC-001 and the RISC-V unprivileged and privileged specifications. Feature-level plan written 2026-10-04. Sign-off criteria: flow/0_signoff_criteria.md. The reference model is Spike, compared instruction by instruction. Methods the flow asks for and that do not exist yet are named on each feature - riscv-arch-test, random instruction generation (riscv-dv), riscv-formal.

NAME: A Instruction set
details: Requirements R-1, R-2.

NAME: F01 Every RV32I instruction executes as the specification says
details: All base instructions, every operand corner.
implementation_note: Method: sim (riscv-arch-test, random instruction generation, lockstep) + formal (riscv-formal). Today: 64 ISA tests pass, 58 of them also compared with Spike (PC, register writes, stores, traps and CSR values); unit benches for decode, ALU, branch unit, immediates

implementation_note: make regress, passing.

implementation_note: Planned.

details: Random instruction streams in lockstep with Spike, many seeds.
implementation_note: make riscv_dv (tb/core/riscv_dv). Passing - nine test types x 20 seeds in lockstep with Spike; with the illegal-instruction test 200 programs, 2458733 instructions, 357979 stores, 5614 traps, 210840 CSR instructions identical.
